main_text.p: Cofroës Persarum Rex, qui Romanis pacem petentibus, superbè respondit: Non parcam vobis tantisper donec Crucifixum illum, quem Deum esse perhibetis, adoraveritis, non autem unà nobiscū Solem: à Siroë filio captus, numellis[?] detentus, à primoribus suis iussu filij cōsputus, tandem etiam telis confixus, miserabiliter perijt: ut supra quoq; dixi.

Verum enimvero, etiam bonis principibus ista nonnunquā evenisse, testantur historiæ, de Mauricio Imperatore, quem cum tota familia Phocas tyrannus occidit: de Hildericho Francorum Rege, in monasterium detruso: de Henrico IIII. Imperatore, qui Pontifice Romano procurante, opera ingrati filij Henrici V. imperatoria dignitate spoliatus, Leodij extremos dies claufit, & sepulcri honore ꝑ[?] annos aliquot caruit: & de multis alijs.

Cominęus lib.5. Historiarum testatur, Arnoldum Ducē Geldriæ, jam natu grandem, ab ingrato filio Adolpho, nocte quadam, cū iam iturus esset cubitum, captū, ac discalceatum, asperrima hyeme per quinq; milliaria abductū, inq; teterrimū car-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "numellis" (possibly a misprint for another word), "ꝑ" before "annos" (abbreviation mark unclear). The catchword "car-" is the start of the next page's first word. Page number read as 118; the first digit is slightly worn. A small mark stands before "Cominęus" in the text column; it is not printed text and was not transcribed. Long s, u/v and i/j normalised per the rules; the printed abbreviations and the ę in "Cominęus" are kept as printed.
